description: Add a video layer. The clip must already be uploaded (the morphareels-sdk's client.addVideo, or the editor). An upload returns { filename, name }: pass `filename` (the stored clip's id) as `clip`, and `name` as the layer's label. To duplicate an existing layer, reuse its clip filename — the editor auto-assigns a fresh id.

clip.description: The stored clip filename an upload returned (an id such as 3f2a9c1e-….mp4, or an older project's own name).

name.description: Optional label people see in the Inspector and Timeline: pass the upload's returned `name`.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
